### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **1** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/page.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/page.md`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx`  _(via PageSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/page.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/page.md`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **216** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **156** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **156**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **101** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **168** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 4d8095ba90d8855f5b1e012d378b9e48b3a5668e` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `cc84837e5bdea3f9516053b7960cd7bff48e9d86` — the merge of head `5b25775652498d9ce56104e498a290e824b32908` into base `4d8095ba90d8855f5b1e012d378b9e48b3a5668e`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin cc84837e5bdea3f9516053b7960cd7bff48e9d86 && git checkout cc84837e5bdea3f9516053b7960cd7bff48e9d86
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 4d8095ba90d8855f5b1e012d378b9e48b3a5668e 5b25775652498d9ce56104e498a290e824b32908 && git checkout -B drift-repro 4d8095ba90d8855f5b1e012d378b9e48b3a5668e && git merge --no-ff 5b25775652498d9ce56104e498a290e824b32908

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 4d8095ba90d8855f5b1e012d378b9e48b3a5668e
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 4d8095ba90d8855f5b1e012d378b9e48b3a5668e` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:ui#2` · head `5b257756` · 2026-11-02T23:07Z

- **形态:** draft PR on `main`, `Fixes #29592` on its own line and no other card number beside a closing keyword. 13 files, +517/−34, Tier S (`check-governed-merges --pr 29631`: 0 of 13 paths governed; under 3000 lines). All inside claim 6588510119 as amended by 6588557190 (the spec's forced followers, the omit row kept with a rewritten reason, the record drawer). The drawer host is `RecordDetailView.tsx` itself (mounted `embedded` under `/apps/:appName/:objectName`), so no extra file. `appObjectScope.ts` touches only `declaredRecordPage` and its one call; #29552's arm came in through the `main` merge cleanly.
- **前提实测:** at `origin/main` the `apps` liveness row read `planned` with the note "the console's page assignment reads no app", and `RecordDetailView.tsx:1049` passed no app. Live on app-crm `--fresh` with a `sys_user` record page `crm_member` scoped `apps: ['crm_app']`: before, the CRM route opened `sys_user_detail`; after, `/apps/com.example.crm/sys_user/record/ID` opens `crm_member` (the name segment canonicalises to the same), and `/apps/com.objectstack.setup/sys_user/record/ID` still opens `sys_user_detail`. The seat looked at all three screenshots in the project files (`issue-29592/before-crm-app-user-record.png`, `after-crm-app-user-record.png`, `after-setup-users-record.png`).
- **门禁 check-runs (pinned to head `5b25775652498d9ce56104e498a290e824b32908`):** 58 success, 7 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending (65 runs), including `Check Changeset`, `Type Check UI`, `Lint UI`, `Test UI` (16 shards), `Build & E2E UI` and `Spec property liveness`. Dev local gates: 107 derived, 107 run, all exit 0, `--ran` 0 NOT-MEASURED; `--tier` no path-derived mandate; ratchets and `check:generated` / `check:liveness` re-run green on this head after merging `main`. New tests 10 + 6 + 3 green; the four existing assignment suites unchanged and green; sweep 291 ui files green. Ablations: raw segment reds 3, hook ignoring the app reds 8, picker ignoring the app reds 2; all restored to HEAD.
- **Code read:** the scoped page is asked through the spec's own `defaultRecordPageObject(page, app)`, the same reading the write doors use to refuse a second page per app, so the first match is the only one. The route compares `matchAppBySegment(...)?.name`, never the segment (flag ③.2 on #29437). With no app named, or no page naming it, every branch falls through to the previous line; the hook's memo keys on `opts.app`, not the options object, so passing `{ app: undefined }` re-renders nothing new.
- **接受的偏差:** the screenshots are not embedded in the PR body (the relay cannot upload images to GitHub); the PR's Acceptance notes describe each one and the seat checked them. The Studio page form still does not offer `apps`: no widget picks a list of app names, and the reconciliation ledger row now says so truthfully.
- **范围外去向:** the Studio form offer of `apps` is not filed: authoring works through code and the metadata API (measured: `PUT /api/v1/meta/page/crm_member` 200), so there is no measured wrong result, only a missing editor. Recorded here. No `Skills-docs:` line is owed.
- **落地条款:** `Clause-②: no` (the resolver reads the existing reserved `app` option; type unchanged; the one caller never passed it, hotcrm has none), `Metadata-protocol: none` (the spec change is describe text and a liveness verdict), `patch` changesets for `@object-ui/react`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@objectstack/spec`; no contract review is owed. Land by `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`.
